tool_description: Retrieve detailed nutritional data and ingredient lists for food items using the USDA FoodData Central database.

api_list.name: get_nutrition
api_list.description: Searches for food items and returns their nutritional profile. For each match, it provides the food description, a list of ingredients, and specific macronutrient values including Calories (kcal), Protein (g), Carbohydrates (g), and Total Fats (g).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The food item or product name to search for (e.g., 'apple', 'big mac', 'greek yogurt').

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of food results to return.
